scope_statement: This manifest covers system-specific controls and the system-specific portion of hybrid controls. Fully inherited controls are implemented by the hosting platform, are tracked in the platform's system security plan, and are outside this harness's verification scope.

controls.description: Environment identifiers (digests, registry paths, hosts, account identifiers, home paths) are redacted from every exported scan artifact; vulnerability identifiers, package names and versions are kept (spec 02 REQ-6.4.2-6.4.3).

mutation.note: the export self-checks its output with redaction_problems; a disarmed redact refuses the bundle
